description: Bornes de recharges IRVE - CA Saint-Quentin-en-Yvelines is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by SAINT-QUENTIN-EN-YVELINES. This data shows charging sites for electric cars under the TD scheme Origin or Source: SQY Reference system: RGF93 - CC49 (EPSG 3949) Geographical completeness: SQY and its surroundings Contact: opendata@sqy.fr. Coverage: SAINT-QUENTIN-EN-YVELINES. The portal shows the English title as "IRVE charging stations - CA Saint-Quentin-en-Yvelines" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is SAINT-QUENTIN-EN-YVELINES. Its keywords include mobilite, recharge, deplacement, voiture-electrique. The listing shows 3 download or service links in URL, GEOJSON. The listing shows 2026-08-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
